Show every lane, route, decision, baton, verification result, and token total.

indicators.label: Controller
indicators.explanation: No governed Run or Work Parcel is active.

indicators.meaning: Lights only for non-terminal controller-owned work.
indicators.persistence: Active while canonical work remains non-terminal; recent for 30 seconds after the last event.
indicators.staleBehavior: An active claim older than 120 seconds is labelled STALE.

indicators.label: Queue
indicators.explanation: The canonical scheduler queue has no waiting Run.
indicators.meaning: Represents queued/scheduled work, not provider activity.
indicators.persistence: Active until each queued Run is dispatched or terminal.
indicators.staleBehavior: A queue entry without a fresh transition is labelled STALE rather than repeatedly pulsed.

indicators.label: Execution lanes
indicators.eventType: canonical lane or Job Run state
indicators.explanation: No workspace lane or governed Job execution lane is active.
indicators.source: canonical lane or Job Run state
indicators.meaning: One coalesced indicator for real active workspace lanes and governed Run execution lanes.
indicators.persistence: Active while at least one workspace lane reports WORKING or a canonical Run remains active.
indicators.staleBehavior: Old last-meaningful-activity converts ACTIVE to STALE.

indicators.label: Tool execution
indicators.explanation: No executing Job step exposes tool activity.
indicators.meaning: Represents recorded step/tool execution; it never guesses hardware activity.
indicators.persistence: Active only while a canonical step is active.
indicators.staleBehavior: An unchanged active step older than 120 seconds is labelled STALE.

indicators.label: Model request
indicators.explanation: No token-runtime thread reports an open provider invocation.
indicators.meaning: An open provider/model invocation with telemetry; not token-stream inference.
indicators.persistence: Active until the provider adapter records completion/failure.
indicators.staleBehavior: An open request without fresh telemetry for 120 seconds is STALE.

indicators.label: Model response
indicators.explanation: Latest completed token thread: openrouter/glm-5.3-flash-parallel-reviewer.
indicators.meaning: A coalesced recent completion pulse, not a claim that tokens streamed.
indicators.persistence: Recent for 30 seconds after a completed thread update.
indicators.staleBehavior: Expires to IDLE; completed work is retained in the ledger.

indicators.label: Baton / escalation
indicators.explanation: Sealed Parcel baton parcel-baton-dd76e175-e5b6-4b79-b2ef-c35d593872e5 carries Parallel lane repository review → the next governed stage: Continue with stages depending on Parallel lane repository review
indicators.meaning: Shows only persisted baton creation, governed handoff or escalation decisions.
indicators.persistence: Active while a handoff is recorded in progress; recent for 30 seconds after its last outcome.
indicators.staleBehavior: A recorded in-progress transfer older than 120 seconds is STALE.

indicators.label: Verification
indicators.explanation: No Run is currently under verification.
indicators.meaning: Tracks independent validation state and recent outcomes.
indicators.persistence: Active during VERIFYING/VALIDATING; recent outcome remains for 30 seconds.
indicators.staleBehavior: An unchanged active verifier older than 120 seconds is STALE.

indicators.label: Node health
indicators.explanation: Configured systems have no active workload or recorded fault.
indicators.meaning: Represents downstream readiness independently from global Agent Control health.
indicators.persistence: Fault states persist until a successful readiness update replaces them.
indicators.staleBehavior: Missing readiness is UNKNOWN; disconnection is never shown as healthy.
